title: Pedagogy and Learning Apprenticeship
description: Under the supervision of an instructor, undergraduate students gain teaching experience through practical experiences in course management and effective teaching methods. Pedagogy and learning apprentices must have a minimum overall grade point average of 3.0. A student may not apprentice more than once for the same course for credit or for more than one course in the same quarter. May be repeated for credit two times. Prerequisites: upper-division standing and consent of instructor.
